probes.label: owner
probes.why: The direct cleanup or effect runs ownerless versus inside a live root; dispose is queued outside render.

probes.label: leaf
probes.why: A present owner-backed onSettled leaf forbids the memo/effect or onCleanup; ordinary component construction accepts it.

probes.label: initial-ref-read
probes.why: Initial access(ref) runs synchronously in the component strict-read window; correct explicitly untracks that read.

probes.label: ref-tracking
probes.why: Skip the synchronous initial ref access; the second call occurs in tracked effect compute and only misuse writes.

probes.label: ref-owner
probes.why: Callable ref adds a guaranteed browser effect; ownerless construction emits NO_OWNER_EFFECT as well as the preexisting direct cleanup warning.

probes.label: event-ref-owner
probes.why: Native fullscreenchange calls access(ref) outside its construction owner; only correct restores that owner before registering cleanup.
